title: Aureline M5 change-intent record
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for one durable change-intent record. Names the object class, its change-intent association, the provider ownership of the tracked work item, the local-versus-provider commit state, the linked branch / worktree / review identity, and the intent lifecycle stage so intent is never scattered across tabs and a local draft never reads as committed. Downstream work-item detail, the start-work sheet, review detail, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating intent by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
